description: The observability spec documents no 404 on GetInstance, DeleteInstance or GetScrapeConfig, so a missing instance or scrape job surfaces as UnknownStackitError. STACKIT's own Terraform provider (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/observability/instance/resource.go and scrapeconfig/resource.go, read 2026-11-01) removes the object from state on http.StatusNotFound in Read and treats http.StatusNotFound as already deleted in Delete. Type it as the model's NotFound so callers can tell a missing object from other failures. No live probe: no credentials exist for this account.
